description:
You are a hosting administrator managing client accounts through Virtualmin. The client AcmeCorp (domain: acmecorp.test) has downgraded from their unlimited plan to the "Basic Business" plan. Apply the following changes to the acmecorp.test virtual server using the Virtualmin web interface:

1. Disk quota: Set the total server quota to 512 MB
2. Bandwidth limit: Set the monthly bandwidth limit to 5 GB (i.e., 5120 MB)
3. Maximum mailboxes: Limit the number of mail/FTP users to 10
4. Maximum aliases: Limit the number of email aliases to 20
5. Maximum databases: Limit the number of databases to 2
6. Administrative password: Change the administration password for this virtual server to Downgraded2024! (the client requested a password reset during the transition)

Make sure to save/apply each change. All modifications should be made to the existing acmecorp.test virtual server — do not create a new server or plan.
